questions.q: Which DAX functions marked a real step up from the Beginner project's measures in this chapter?
options: VLOOKUP and INDEX
CALCULATE, DATEADD, ALL, AVERAGEX, and DIVIDE
No new DAX functions were introduced
Only SUM and COUNT, same as the Beginner project
questions.explain: These filter-context-manipulating and row-context functions went beyond the Beginner project's plain SUM/DISTINCTCOUNT measures.

questions.q: Why does this course treat Lessons 10-12 (the bug) as core project skill, not a detour?
options: Diagnosing a real mismatch calmly and systematically is itself one of the most common, genuine BI developer skills
Bugs are rare in real BI work and were included only for novelty
The bug lessons were optional and don't reflect real work
Diagnosing bugs has nothing to do with being a BI developer
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly frames root-cause diagnosis as a real, named, common skill — not an aside from 'real' development.

questions.q: What distinguishes this Intermediate capstone from the Beginner capstone, structurally?
options: It is identical in scope to the Beginner project
Multiple tables with real relationships, two pages for two audiences, a schedule, a bug, and a change request — not just more content
It avoids using AdventureWorks2012 in favor of a different database
It uses a completely different, unrelated fictional company
questions.explain: The Intermediate project adds genuine breadth and responsibility beyond the Beginner project's single-stakeholder, single-page, one-time build.

questions.q: What does this lesson say about the path's Advanced capstone ahead?
options: It repeats this exact same project with no new content
It removes the need for staging views or data modeling entirely
It goes further still, with larger, more production-style builds, building on this project's foundation rather than starting over
It is unrelated to anything covered in this chapter
questions.explain: The lesson frames the Advanced capstone as a continuation that builds on the staging, modeling, DAX, and diagnosis skills from this project.

questions.q: What does the Lesson 16 self-assessment lab specifically ask you to identify?
options: The exact dollar total of company-wide sales
The single hardest lesson in this chapter and the specific concept that took the most re-reading
A list of every AdventureWorks2012 table that exists
A ranking of all 16 lessons from easiest to hardest
questions.explain: The lab asks for a specific, honest reflection useful for deciding what to review before the Advanced capstone.
